BS01.desc: Instantly teleports 400 units in the target direction, stopping short of walls.
BS02.desc: Removes all crowd control effects and grants crowd control immunity for 1.5 seconds.
BS03.desc: Restores 15% HP to yourself and the ally with the lowest HP% within 800 units, and grants both +20% move speed for 2 seconds.

BS09.desc: After a 3-second channel, teleports to a chosen allied tower or your fountain. Taking damage interrupts the channel.
BS10.desc: Slows an enemy hero within 650 units by 40% and reduces their damage dealt by 30% for 2.5 seconds.
